system_overview: museum-audio-guide is a QR-triggered audio guide with multilingual tracks. It is built as a small focused system with QR Resolver at its core, supported by Track Streamer and Visit Analytics (privacy-first).

recommended_language.rationale: TypeScript fits the QR-triggered audio guide with multilingual tracks workload on technical grounds.

quality_goals.goal: Correct output under normal failure modes

architecture_decisions.title: Use QR Resolver as the system core
architecture_decisions.rationale: The QR-triggered audio guide with multilingual tracks hinges on this component working well.

positive: Single place to harden the critical path
negative: Core component becomes a bottleneck for change

ruled_out.rejection_reason: Operational overhead for a small system.

architecture_decisions.title: Run Visit Analytics (privacy-first) asynchronously
architecture_decisions.rationale: Keeps the interactive path fast on modest hardware.

ruled_out.rejection_reason: Ties user latency to slow external work.

what_not_to_build: A plugin system before there are users

risk_flags.risk: External dependency outage stalls the async path
risk_flags.mitigation: Retry with backoff and a dead-letter table.

open_questions: What is the realistic peak concurrent usage?
constraints: Entities Exhibit, Track, Visit must persist relationally
Components: QR Resolver, Track Streamer, Visit Analytics (privacy-first)
